'''Sayda Island''' (Japanese: '''サイダ島''' ''Sayda Island'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Kanto]].

Sayda Island is a heavily forested area, with a rocky, mountainous portion that is notable for being where {{OBP|Crystal|HS15}} found the Fossilized {{p|Aerodactyl}} Egg. This Egg, along with a sample of [[Old Amber]], was used by {{Gary}} and Crystal's sister, [[Dora]], to revive an Aerodactyl, which broke free of the lab.

Sayda Island also has fruit trees, the fruit of which Aerodactyl has been depicted to enjoy eating.

==Places of interest==
===Sayda Lab===
[[File:Sayda Lab.png|thumb|left|220px|Sayda Lab]]
The Sayda Lab is a specialized [[Fossil]] research facility lead by [[Dora]]. Following his journey through the [[Johto]] [[region]], {{Gary}} landed a position at Sayda Lab and went on to revive an {{p|Aerodactyl}}, its first resurrected Pokémon, from DNA recovered from a fossilized {{pkmn|Egg}} and [[Old Amber]].

The facility also houses an extensive collection of fossilized remains and a large display with life-size reconstructions of all the [[Kanto]] Fossil Pokémon.
